en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an industrial mining complex beside a body of water. On the right stands a large brick and timber industrial building with a smokestack; on the left, additional mine buildings and a tall chimney emitting smoke, with a headframe structure visible. The foreground is a pond or reservoir with grassy banks. The caption at the bottom left in red letters reads "Freiberg. Grube Himmelfahrt," and the bottom margin contains a small printer's imprint.
